summary: Retire obsolete dependency generations atomically into an unselectable garbage namespace before recursive deletion.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only immutable dependency cache. Five-file keys and published generation contents remain unchanged; leftover garbage is cleaned without generation verification.

recovery.detail: Interrupted retirement/deletion no longer leaves a corrupt public generation. Selection drops retired identities before rename, and later population cleans garbage opportunistically.
